environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL (regional scope) with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'block-traversal-in-body' with priority 1 that inspects the request BODY with a RegexPatternSet matching '(?:\.\.[\\/]){2,}' and '\.\.\/\.\.\/\.\.\/' with action BLOCK and TextTransformation URL_DECODE applied, (3) a custom rule 'content-type-restrict' that blocks requests to /api/v2/documents/upload unless Content-Type contains 'multipart/form-data' AND the body size is under 10MB. The WAF is configured with BLOCK as default action for matched rules. CloudWatch metrics confirm the traversal rule fires on zip filenames containing path traversal sequences in multipart form bodies. Note: WAF inspects the first 8KB of the request body by default (oversizeAction: CONTINUE), but the multipart boundary and filename field appear within the first 2KB of typical uploads.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, WAFv2 Web ACL associated

waf_rules.name: block-traversal-in-body
waf_rules.statement: RegexPatternSet match on BODY with URL_DECODE transform

config.filesystem: ext4, no mount restrictions, AppArmor disabled
